name: B&M gabled frontage
observations: Large orange/red-brick shopping-centre mass with repeated steep gables and tall projecting piers.
Blue/orange B&M signs sit on lower brick bays; separate Big Brands/Big Savings side-entry panel visible further south.
Dark-framed upper windows include a tall projecting Y-pattern bay and a pair of smaller recessed windows under brick arches.
Blank/bricked-up tall recesses, dentil-like brick detailing and vertical black downpipes are visible.
Market canopies and fruit tables occupy the pavement; parked cars/vans cover lower wall and entrances.
Do not flatten the gables, bay or piers into one photo plane.
unknowns: Full lower entrance layout behind market/vehicles remains occluded.
Shared mass/ownership with Town Square complex is inferred from adjacency, not confirmed interior connectivity.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.

map_position.method: Estimated offset from photographed camera route; B050 uses Google place pin. Not measured building geometry.
